records.title: Interpretability Can Be Actionable
records.reason: Interpretability Can Be Actionable studies using interpretability signals to change model behavior. It references cost-aware routing but does not itself present a concrete inference-cost/latency reduction method.

records.title: ResRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Negative Sample Projection Residual Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: ResRL is a residual reinforcement-learning training method for LLM reasoning. Its reported gains are training/reasoning performance, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Trustworthy Koopman Operator Learning: Invariance Diagnostics and Error Bounds
records.reason: Trustworthy Koopman Operator Learning studies invariance diagnostics/error bounds for dynamical systems; it does not address LLM inference.

records.title: CuTe Layout Representation and Algebra
records.reason: CuTe Layout Representation and Algebra formalizes GPU tensor layouts relevant to tiled kernel implementations. It is low-level accelerator infrastructure, but the paper does not evaluate an LLM inference kernel or serving gain.

records.title: Bending the Scaling Law Curve in Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
records.reason: This work studies scaling laws and unified architecture for recommendation systems. Its system/compute implications are recommendation-specific and no direct LLM inference result is established.
